06 — Story

About Me

4+
Years of
Learning
Machine Learning Deep Learning NLP Cloud (AWS) Data Analytics

Hi! I'm Iniyan C, a Machine Learning Engineer and aspiring Cloud Practitioner from Namakkal, Tamil Nadu. I build intelligent systems that transform raw data into meaningful predictions, real-time inferences, and actionable insights.

Currently pursuing B.Tech in Artificial Intelligence & Data Science at Paavai College of Engineering (CGPA: 7.7), I've completed 3 internships across ML engineering, data analytics, and AI research — building everything from EduSense AI (a full-stack ML platform with 20+ API endpoints) to a published brain tumor classifier.

"I don't just train models — I engineer ML systems that scale, explain, and deliver measurable value to real-world problems."

My technical toolkit spans Python, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, NLP pipelines, Flask REST APIs, Power BI, and AWS Cloud services. I'm currently pursuing the AWS Cloud Practitioner certification to bridge ML and cloud deployment at scale.
